tasks.description: Wire the accepted care reminder lifecycle into Root using existing auth/scene/locale and cache-publication events; no settings, permission UI, delegate, routes or new network work.
constraints: Strict small ROOT-ONLY wiring, ideally ~100-150 added lines. Only PlantsApp.swift may change. Accepted Core06739f3 and Authfd7c72b interfaces are fixed; do not modify them. No settings/consent/permission UI, delegate, route, fixture flags, backend/deploy/live writes, new HTTP, sync loop, SDK observer, Trial or camera/AI/purchase work. No new files/PBX. Preserve old UI assertions, selectors and flows. User wants technical acceptance only. Source/modelexisting models900/budgets unchanged; usage fresh admission must be <93, hard95/no reset.

Root owns one @StateObject CareReminderLifecycle initialized with inert SystemCareReminderNotifications, UserDefaults.standard, Date clock and dynamic TimeZone.current. Constructor has no OS effects. Its worker is Combine ObservableObject; use accepted lifecycle forwarding. Default per-owner opt-in remains false, no Root enable/permission call. Initial unavailable SDK/config and .unresolved mean suspendAuth/HOLD, never logout/cancelAll based on hasResolvedAuth, snapshot nil or sticky didSignOut. Verified .anonymous or current .signedOut classification means logout cleanup. Recheck current classification before applying stale async mapping.

Use existing CatalogueConnection.authClassification, not another SDK subscription. For .permanent(snapshot), retain a notification context under the original collectionLease(expected:snapshot), store, syncAuthority and syncEngine. Guard original classification, lease and locale before/after every await. Scope must be independent of TodayModel.scope and scenePhase. Core Context.isCurrent captures original connection/snapshot/locale, NOT scenePhase or UI activation. Avoid retaining Root itself in this long-lived closure; capture connection/language objects. Owner A-B-A/token refresh/locale change must retire stale mapping without transferring an old lease. Auth unresolved preserves armed future requests while withholding new adds.

Map scene active/inactive through setSceneActive; background, clearToday and onDisappear do NOT mean logout or desired-empty. Core local/canonical subscriptions remain independent of active-only Today. Do not duplicate its streams or call care reconciliation from reminder callbacks. Keep all existing care lifecycle and collection presentation behavior intact.

After the existing repository.refreshCareOverview operation returns, notify Core via cachePublicationOrTimeChanged even if Today publication is later discarded by UI revision/scene checks. Hook must occur before a scene-bound requireToday can throw, and must guard the actual current reminder owner/SDK scope so late owner-A results do not mark owner-B dirty. No second overview GET, sync or care command. Known denial/revalidation publication also needs a current local reread. Timer/clock hooks read only the existing cache and existing dates; a tiny cancellation-aware known-deadline/day hook is allowed, no Store polling or invented due dates. Existing Home localBoundary callback can also notify Core.

CRITICAL fixture isolation: before any System runtime start, guard ALL existing DEBUG catalogue/Today fixtures and staging-analysis mode, including bootstrap before fixtureContext assignment. Do not call logout/cancelAll for a fixture owner; suspend an inert Core instead. Ordinary Release uses System, existing fixture UI uses NONE of its real inventory/permission/add/remove methods. Do not add a new fixture or bypass. Preserve exact old13 care+ledger, new6 Today+readonly-ledgers and PL replay checks. No existing ordinary live proof from56d may be attributed to this new Root.

Mandatory full Swift/build/welcome,149 automation,MCP,old13 care UI+4POST ledger,Today6+8 readonly namespaces,PL UI+replay, high Review/QA. New Root source is not evidence of user-facing reminder readiness: settings/delegate/System roundtrip/closed-app delivery remain open. Do not close parent tasks. No actual phone/user-data/backend mutation is part of these gates.
